band_green: No warning signs in this check. Keep storing as you are.
band_red: Check this batch before selling it. Take a sample to the cooperative.
band_not_sure: Not sure. Ask a person at the cooperative.
reason_rewetted: The coffee got wet after drying started.
reason_damp_check: Your hand or bite test did not find the beans dry.
reason_humid_weeks: These weeks are usually humid here.
reason_floor: The bags are on the floor.
reason_long_storage: The coffee has been stored a long time.
reason_out_of_range: One answer is outside what this check was built for.
reason_low_confidence: This check cannot tell for this batch.
action_test_sample: Take a sample to the cooperative's moisture meter.
action_redry: Dry this batch again before you store or sell it.
action_raise_bags: Move the bags off the floor onto a pallet or rack.
consent_text: Your batch records stay on this phone. This app sends nothing. If you choose to send the SMS, you send it yourself. You can delete all records in Settings.
sms_template: Hello. My stored coffee ({batch_label}) needs checking. Can I bring a sample to the moisture meter this week?
synthetic_label: SYNTHETIC_DEMO. Demo only: this check learned from made-up examples, not from real coffee tests.
